purpose: Execute the already-frozen v2 many-to-many exact-match rule in bounded storage by reading the exact official snapshot once as a verified byte stream rather than materializing the 35.09 GB archive or downloading it twice.

trigger.reason: The exact compressed snapshot is 35,093,052,336 bytes while the standard execution environment does not have enough free local disk to materialize it. The archive member order places observations before photos, so the path-based v2 implementation would otherwise require a second full archive pass.

one_pass_observation_prefilter.role: I/O optimization only; this does not change which association rows can be exact matches under v2
one_pass_observation_prefilter.source_of_target_values: the already frozen 60,000-row live metadata manifest
one_pass_observation_prefilter.linked_observation_that_fails_prefilter: deterministic nonmatch sentinel for final v2 exact-match counting; it is not treated as a missing selected candidate
one_pass_observation_prefilter.proof_obligation: unit tests must show equality of final exact-match decisions between the original full two-pass v2 resolver and one-pass prefiltering when nonmatching extra links are present, and must preserve ambiguity when multiple links satisfy all frozen observation-side fields

unchanged_final_resolution.multiple_match_rule: not_evaluable and STOP as ambiguous without replacement

claim_ceiling: Exact source/provenance reconciliation only. No image pixels, flower ROI, colour, spatial boundary, environmental concordance, pollinator concordance or biological inference is permitted by this amendment.
